name: slippage_sqrt_binding
description: A large order relative to ADV makes the square-root term bind: 20 bps beats the 2 bps floor. All numbers are chosen so the square root is exact by hand.
derivation: order_notional=2.5e6, daily_vol=0.04, adv_notional=1e9, y=1.0, min_bps=2.0. ratio=2.5e6/1e9=0.0025; sqrt(0.0025)=0.05; raw=y*daily_vol*sqrt(ratio)*1e4=1.0*0.04*0.05*1e4=20.0 bps. slippage=max(2.0, 20.0)=20.0 bps.
